d: Yah 'kovid aveyarnes siriz' ka dusra vidiyo hai. ismen korona vaiksin se juri suraksha chintaon ka samadhan kiya gaya hai taki hamara samaj aphvahon se bachte hue medikal sains par bharosa rakh sake. ismen samjhaya gaya hai ki kuchh logon ko vaiksin lene ke bad bhi korona kyon hota hai aur kuchh logon ki mrityu kyon huee hai? sath hi, kuchh prachlit shabdon jaise Efficacy, Emergency Approval, AEFI, Co-morbities aadi ko bhi aasan bhasha men spasht kiya gaya hai.
